full_details.title: WordPress & GeneratePress Specialist Needed
full_details.full_description:
We are looking for an experienced and reliable WordPress professional to assist with minor updates to a newly launched website.

You must be highly experienced with WordPress, GeneratePress, GenerateBlocks, Gutenberg, and block-based page layouts. This is an existing website, so you must be comfortable making changes without disrupting the current design or structure.

Work will include replacing and uploading videos and images, checking and updating links, minor content edits, and small layout or formatting changes.

Strong WordPress, GeneratePress and GenerateBlocks experience
Excellent written English and grammatical skills
Excellent communication and ability to follow instructions
Honest, responsible and dependable
Ability to complete small assignments promptly and carefully
No AI-generated or bot responses

This is an initial paid test project. YOUR BID IS WHAT YOU AGREE TO DO THIS INITIAL TEST PROJECT FOR. NO NEGOTIATION.  We are looking for the right person to continue on with a monthly retainer, and I must be assured that money is secondary to your work product and your desire for the opportunity for additional work as the project grows.

Generic, AI-generated or copy-and-paste proposals, New Freelancers without reviews or portfolios as well as sealed bid will NOT be considered.  Must state the words: I wrote this proposal exclusively for this project.  Begin with Hi Jay.  Thanks all.
